definitions.explanation: In baseball, the number of official times a batter comes to the plate, excluding walks, sacrifices, and hit-by-pitches. The denominator used to calculate batting average.

examples.japanese: ⟦{四|よん}→四：00767_yon⟧{打|だ}{数|すう}⟦{二|に}→二：00736_ni⟧⟦{安打|あんだ}→安打：19717_anda⟧だった。
⟦{打率|だりつ}→打率：07113_daritsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{安打数|あんだすう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{打|だ}{数|すう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{割|わ}って→割る：02334_waru⟧⟦{求|もと}める→求める：02316_motomeru⟧。
examples.english: Batting average is found by dividing hits by at-bats.

examples.japanese: {今季|こんき}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{規定|きてい}→規定：14136_kitei⟧{打|だ}{数|すう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{達|たっ}して→達する：02129_tassuru⟧⟦{首位打者|しゅいだしゃ}→首位打者：26604_shuidasha⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{争|あらそ}っている→争う：01866_arasou⟧。
examples.english: This season he has reached the required at-bats and is contending for the batting title.

notes:
A baseball statistic. Walks ({四球|しきゅう}), sacrifices, and hit-by-pitches are counted separately as plate appearances (⟦{打席|だせき}→打席：06542_daseki⟧) but not as {打|だ}{数|すう}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{四|よん}→四：00767_yon⟧{打|だ}{数|すう}{一|いち}⟦{安打|あんだ}→安打：19717_anda⟧: one hit in four at-bats
- ⟦{規定|きてい}→規定：14136_kitei⟧{打|だ}{数|すう}: the minimum at-bats to qualify for a title
- ⟦{無|む}→無：17750_mu⟧{打|だ}{数|すう}: no official at-bats

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{打席|だせき}→打席：06542_daseki⟧: plate appearance — every trip to the plate, including walks and sacrifices
